about_the_game:
Mp4 with subtitles in wav area

About 30 mins

The Dark and Shy Ms. Minji's Normie Transformation Plan?!

Story Summary:

Ms. Minji usually hides in the shadows, secretly observing from afar. But this time… things are different. She finally arranged a meetup with her online guildmates and is about to interact with real people in the real world!

The problem? She has absolutely no idea how to talk to humans.

And so, today’s special training is all about improving Ms. Minji’s social skills!
🔹 How to NOT make people think you're a creepy stalker
🔹 Learn to make eye contact! (Running away blushing is NOT allowed!)
🔹 How to smile normally instead of looking… unsettling

You (the player) will take on the role of her “Social Skills Coach”, guiding her through this ASMR-style social training. But every time she tries, she either makes weird noises from extreme embarrassment or says something totally not normal…

💬 “Ehh…? Are you sure talking like this won’t scare them off…?”
💬 “My smile needs to look more natural? But… isn’t this how I always smile…?” (proceeds to grin eerily)
💬 “I shouldn’t stand in front of them for five minutes without saying anything? B-but… how else am I supposed to analyze their behavioral patterns…?”

Will you be able to transform this socially awkward, shadow-dwelling teacher into a proper normie?! 😈
